description: Control Antigravity from Telegram, target specific conversations, and use English or Italian.
config.title: Antigravity With Telegram
config.language: Extension and default Telegram language. English is the default; each Telegram chat can override it with /language en|it.
config.autoStart: Automatically start the Telegram bot when the IDE opens.
config.chatId: Telegram Chat ID allowed to control the IDE. Leave empty if using an allowed username.
config.username: Telegram username (without @) allowed to control the IDE.
config.terminalEnabled: Allow Telegram /run for explicitly permitted commands only. Disabled by default.
config.terminalAllowed: Allowed non-privileged command prefixes for /run. Commands execute without a shell.
config.terminalSudo: Allowed privileged command prefixes. /run sudo always uses sudo -n and requires a preconfigured sudoers NOPASSWD rule; passwords are never accepted or stored.
config.terminalTimeout: Maximum remote command timeout in seconds (1–300).
config.terminalMaxOutput: Maximum stdout/stderr characters returned to Telegram (1,000–30,000).
